source.title: Marilee - Forest's Arrow
source.name: Marilee
source.description: A deft Marksman who is better positioned farther from enemies.

skills.name: Mid-Air Shot

description.raw: Marilee leaps up to 2 tiles in any direction, shooting the 2 closest enemies to her initial tile and dealing 125% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to them.
active: Marilee leaps up to 2 tiles in any direction, shooting the 2 closest enemies to her initial tile and dealing 125% (ATK-based) + 15% (SP-based) damage to them.

skills.description_lite: Marilee leaps to a far location while shooting at targets.

skills.name: Mighty Arrow

description.raw: Marilee briefly charges up her next normal attack after every 2 normal attacks, dealing 160% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage and stunning the target for 0.5s.
active: Marilee briefly charges up her next normal attack after every 2 normal attacks, dealing 160% (ATK-based) + 10% (SP-based) damage and stunning the target for 0.5s.

skills.description_lite: Marilee launches a might shoot and stuns a target after every 2 normal attacks.

skills.name: Hyperfocus

description.raw: Marilee increases ATK by 4% + 1% (SP-based) and ATK SPD by 25 when there's no enemy within 2 tiles.
active: Marilee increases ATK by 4% + 1% (SP-based) and ATK SPD by 25 when there's no enemy within 2 tiles.

skills.description_lite: Marilee increases ATK and ATK SPD when no enemies are nearby.

skills.name: Hero Focus

description.raw: Increases Crit DMG Boost by 30 during battle.
active: Increases Crit DMG Boost by 30 during battle.

text: Increases Crit DMG Boost by 40 during battle.
Increases Crit DMG Boost by 50 during battle.

skills.description_lite: Increases Crit DMG Boost during battle.

skills.name: Battlefield Learning

description.raw: Marilee increases her ATK by 5% when allies cast an Ultimate, up to 6 stacks. Her normal attacks deal true damage after reaching max stacks.
active: Marilee increases her ATK by 5% when allies cast an Ultimate, up to 6 stacks.
Her normal attacks deal true damage after reaching max stacks.

text: Gains an extra stack of Battlefield Learning when Hyperfocus takes effect for every 10s.
Increases each stack of ATK bonus to 7.5%.
Increases each stack of ATK bonus to 8.5%.

skills.description_lite: Marilee increases her ATK when allies cast an Ultimate. Her normal attacks deal true damage after reaching max stacks.

description.raw: Marilee reduces the required no-enemy range for triggering Hyperfocus by 1 tile.
active: Marilee reduces the required no-enemy range for triggering Hyperfocus by 1 tile.
